caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted head, rendered in color, showing detailed facial features and a headdress. The head is topped with a tall, angular, multi-faceted headdress that is colored in shades of red, brown, and ochre, with several darker spots and shadows indicating depth and curvature. Below the headdress, the figure has dark, wavy hair or a band wrapped around the head, colored in black and dark brown. The face is elongated, with a prominent nose, deeply set eyes with visible eyelids, and arched eyebrows, all depicted in earth-toned colors such as beige, brown, and tan. The cheeks and forehead display shading that emphasizes the structure. The figure has a full, dark beard with sections of black and brown, with a pointed mustache and a triangular goatee. The expression of the face is neutral, with the eyes looking slightly downward and to the left. The drawing is set against a plain, light background with some shadowing for emphasis. At the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten inscription in green ink: "Miguel A. Ochoa, Taos N.M."
title: Head of San Jose
